Stage 5 · Java foundations

Inheritance: Hand-Me-Downs

Children reuse parents. Say “X is a Y” aloud — or compose.

⏱ 15 min🧠 No experience needed🧪 Interactive
Step 1

Jackets + extras

One donor only (no diamonds).

🧥

Family wardrobe. Parent owns name, walk(). Student extends Person: inherits all, adds grade. Java allows ONE class donor — interfaces give many later.

Student sketch
class Person {
  String name;
  Person(String n) { name = n; }
}
class Student extends Person {
  int grade;
  Student(String n, int g) {
    super(n);   // build the Person part FIRST
    grade = g;  // then add the Student part
  }
}
Student s = new Student("Ada", 90); // name Ada, grade 90
super(n) builds the parent slice FIRST. Children add, never remove. “Book is a Library”? Fails → compose!
